widgets_values:
<Picture 1> establishes Subject 1, an adult East Asian woman with a realistic face, elegant hairstyle, slim body proportions, silver-white Y2K-inspired dress, accessories, and high heels. Preserve her identity, face, hairstyle, outfit, and body proportions.

<Picture 2> establishes Subject 2, a large red futuristic combat mech with heavy mechanical armor, complex joints, metallic red panels, black mechanical components, and a powerful humanoid silhouette. Preserve the mech’s overall design language, armor structure, mechanical proportions, and red-black color palette.

<Picture 3> establishes Object 1, a dark luxury perfume bottle with a wooden cap and premium minimalist design. Preserve the bottle shape, dark translucent glass, wooden cap, and elegant premium appearance. Ignore all text, logos, and branding visible in the reference.

Scene:
A clean futuristic luxury showroom with restrained lighting and a slightly surreal fashion-film atmosphere.

Subject 1 stands beside Object 1 while Subject 2 remains completely motionless in the background like a dormant display machine.

Subject 1 calmly picks up the perfume bottle and sprays a small amount onto her wrist.

A delicate perfume mist drifts through the air toward Subject 2.

The mist enters the small openings in Subject 2’s chest armor.

Suddenly, Subject 2 activates.

Its chest core lights up, its eyes illuminate, and several mechanical joints move into position with subtle metallic sounds.

At first, Subject 2 assumes a strong defensive stance.

Subject 1 looks at the mech calmly instead of reacting with fear.

She slowly raises one arm.

Subject 2 pauses, observes her, then imitates the exact same arm movement.

Subject 1 performs another elegant gesture.

Subject 2 copies her again, slightly delayed.

This gradually develops into a short, playful human-and-mech synchronized dance.

Subject 1 performs elegant, restrained Y2K fashion-dance movements while Subject 2 attempts to reproduce them using its heavy mechanical body.

The contrast should feel humorous, stylish, and visually surprising rather than chaotic.

Subject 1 turns, extends one arm, steps sideways, and makes a graceful body movement.

Subject 2 follows with a heavier mechanical version of the same choreography.

The two finally stop side by side.

Subject 2 stands slightly behind Subject 1 like an enormous mechanical bodyguard.

CRITICAL TALKING RULE:
When Subject 1 speaks, she must face the camera directly.
Her face must be fully frontal and clearly visible.
Her eyes look directly into the lens.
Her lips remain completely visible.
She must not speak in profile, turn away, look down, or allow her hair, hands, perfume bottle, or Subject 2 to block her face.

Subject 1 looks directly into the camera with a small confident smile and says:

<d>[Chinese] 看来，它喜欢这个味道。</d>

Immediately after the sentence, Subject 2’s chest core flashes softly once.

Final shot:
brief close visual emphasis on Object 1.
The dark perfume liquid inside the bottle appears slightly lower than before, subtly suggesting that the perfume may actually be the mech’s mysterious energy source.

Camera:
stable cinematic medium-wide framing during the interaction;
slow controlled push-in;
keep both Subject 1 and Subject 2 clearly readable;
slightly closer framing during the final direct-to-camera dialogue.

Visual style:
realistic live-action East Asian woman,
premium Y2K fashion editorial,
high-detail realistic red mech,
luxury perfume commercial aesthetic,
surreal fashion film,
soft cinematic lighting,
dark metallic red, silver, black and amber palette,
realistic skin, glass, metal and fabric textures,
stylish, playful and sophisticated.

Constraints:
preserve Subject 1 identity and costume;
preserve Subject 2 mech design;
preserve Object 1 perfume bottle shape and materials;
no extra people;
no extra robots;
no combat;
no explosions;
no aggressive attack;
no body merging;
no random transformation;
no cartoon movement;
no face occlusion;
no profile dialogue;
no back-facing dialogue;
do not reproduce logos or text from Picture 3.
